tagline: Your Vision. Our Strategy. Real Impact.
heroLead: Events, communications and consultancy shaped with purpose and delivered with precision.
aboutIntro: Your idea deserves a team that cares as much as you do.
aboutText: Global Digital Centre is a full-service Events, PR & Communications and Consultancy firm in Nairobi. We bring strategic thinking, creative design and technical expertise together for public institutions, development partners, corporates and communities.

aboutValues.title: Care in every detail
aboutValues.text: From the first plan to the final moment.

servicesIntro: An event, a story, a new direction. Bring us your brief and we’ll bring the right mix of strategy, creativity and care.

services.title: Event Design, Management & Technical Support
services.summary: Thoughtful events, from the first idea to a seamless experience on the day.
services.detail: Event design, stages, exhibition booths, audio-visual production, coordination, logistics and vendor management.

services.title: Public Relations & Communications
services.summary: Clear communication that builds trust and connects you with the right people.
services.detail: Media relations, campaigns, stakeholder engagement, crisis communication, digital strategy and editorial content.

services.title: Creative Design, Branding & Digital Solutions
services.summary: Distinct brands and digital experiences that make your story stand out.
services.detail: Brand identity, campaign and event graphics, motion creative, publications and website design.

services.title: Simultaneous Interpretation Equipment & Services
services.summary: Language support and conference technology that bring everyone into the conversation.
services.detail: Interpreter booths, multi-channel audio systems, interpreters and technical integration.

services.title: Photography, Videography & Livestreaming
services.summary: Photography, films and livestreams that let your story travel beyond the room.
services.detail: Event coverage, documentary and corporate video, live streams, photography and post-production.

services.title: Data Analysis & Visualization
services.summary: Turning research and data into clear stories that support decisions and reporting.
services.detail: Analysis, dashboards, infographics, monitoring and evaluation visuals, and data storytelling.

services.title: Consultancy & Research
services.summary: Practical advice, grounded in research, to help you move forward with confidence.
services.detail: Manufacturing, climate and renewable energy, public sector advice, market intelligence and project support.

approach.description: We start with your objectives, audience and the result you need.
Our team develops a clear creative, strategic and delivery plan.
The right people and technical detail bring the plan to life.
We review what worked and what should come next.

why.title: Connected thinking
why.description: Strategy, creative work, communications and technical delivery work together.

why.title: Care in execution
why.description: A coordinated team keeps the details, people and deadlines in view.

why.title: Built around the brief
why.description: The approach follows the client, audience and purpose of each project.
